What we do

Three ways into the unknown

Research & the Unknown Brain series

We aim to create change through the complex process of research. Our Student-Led Research Journal publishes literature reviews on neuroscience and psychology topics we find genuinely worth writing about.

What we're building.

In development

Sensory Audit Initiative

We're exploring a public audit initiative focused on sensory environments. The idea is still early, and not yet confirmed or partnered with anyone.

We'll update this section as the initiative moves from concept to something concrete. If you're interested in being part of it early, reach out.

The cohort

Meet the interns running it

Each cohort is mentored directly by our founders and takes on real responsibility in running The UnknownNow.

Apply to the next cohort

Turn a research paper into a clear, accurate literature review. Writers pick a topic, read the studies, and draft articles for the Unknown Brain series with an editor's feedback.

Check claims against their sources, tighten the writing, and make sure every article is accurate and readable before it is published.

Create the visuals that go with the research: graphics, layouts and social posts that make a complex idea easy to see.

Grow our readership through Instagram, partnerships with other student groups, and getting the research in front of people who would want it.
